req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept POST requests to create tasks without a description field. This implies that the description field is optional. The test suite will include a positive test to verify that a task can be created without a description, a negative test to ensure that missing required fields result in an error, and a boundary test to check the behavior when the description is exactly at its maximum length.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send POST request to /tasks/ with a payload missing the description field.
expected: Response payload contains the task with the correct title and default completed status.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task"}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"
assert response.json()["description"] is None
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send POST request to /tasks/ with a payload missing the title field.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "Task without title"}
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_length_description
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send POST request to /tasks/ with a description field at maximum length.
expected: Response payload contains the task with the correct title and description.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_description = "x" * 500
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": max_length_description}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Boundary Task"
assert response.json()["description"] == max_length_description
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
